purpose: Affected-only Order 107 native PDF table capability and non-destructive Calc listener registration for both closed applications and existing GUI-opened Office processes.

repair_hypothesis.description: Native PDF table reading preserves cell boundaries and merge geometry without interpreting labels or calculating values. V1 exposed a closed Calc listener after Holo's wrong-window close; V2 exposed a GUI-reopened live Office without its UNO listener. Official LibreOffice 7.3.7.2 IPC source confirms that a same-profile soffice --accept invocation registers a listener in the running process. Passive lifecycle now uses that mechanism without killing a live process, removing its profile locks, reopening a document or replaying setup; it waits for the actual listener even after the IPC client exits 0. Semantic arguments remain unchanged and lifecycle provenance and shared request budget are preserved.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Model-selected Calc calls can recover the listener after ordinary GUI reopening and then execute their unchanged semantic request, allowing observed-file correction, native PDF table reading and spreadsheet writes. Only the original evaluator PASS counts as task recovery; listener success or unit tests do not.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One affected-only fresh-VM V3 attempt, 100 global/50 local steps, one same-VM restart, 1800 Agent seconds and 30 GiB disk stop. Freeze source through supervisor exit. Preserve the first terminal outcome; skip a behavioral failure absent a newly demonstrated concrete defect. No unchanged replay, control/regression episode, full run, new gate, evaluator change, commit or promotion.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Preserve original failed hybrid episodes and the two negative September 9 header request probes. Native-table V1 was interrupted at 22 events, reward null, after missing-listener errors; V2 was interrupted at 34 events, reward null, after its first workbook reads proved a live-process/no-listener state. V2 read batch PDF text, exposed native tables in model search/tools, and issued one GUI cell-entry action but never selected native table reading. Both source seals matched through process exit; neither evaluator ran. The two-attempt checkpoint is explicitly extended by the new native IPC mechanism evidence and focused verification, not an unchanged repeat.

selection.method: Affected-only Order 107 third attempt after two preserved distinct listener-state interruptions; native IPC registration now covers the live GUI-opened case while preserving documents.
